home.tagline: Every AI coding agent on this machine, in one place.
home.intro: Versions, config files, skills and MCP servers, read straight from your disk — for this machine's agents and for your own projects. Nothing is uploaded.
home.projectsNone: Add a folder to work in
home.agentsHint: Versions, configs, skills and MCP servers of every agent Ahabby knows.
home.projectsHint: Your own folders, and the skills, MCP servers and documents each project holds.
home.libraryHint: Everything installed across your agents, plus the shared resources of the machine.
home.hubHint: Published collections of skills and MCP servers, installed into an agent, a project or the shared surface.
home.settingsHint: Language, theme, scan paths, terminal and the catalog.
home.aboutBody: Ahabby is a local control panel for the AI coding agents on this machine and for the projects you work in. It finds them, reads their configuration, and gathers versions, skills and MCP servers into one place — and the Hub adds what is missing from published collections. Teaching it a new agent takes one manifest, not new code.
home.hubInstallTitle: Installs what you do not have yet
home.hubInstallHint: The Hub reads published collections of skills and MCP servers and writes the one you pick through the same path checks, backups and config edits as the manual forms.
home.localHint: Your files are never uploaded. The network is used only for the version check and for the collections you open in the Hub; the version check can be turned off in Settings.
home.backupHint: An edit is shown as a diff first, and the file on disk is copied with a timestamp before it is replaced.
home.commandsHint: Install, update and uninstall run the command from the agent's own manifest — nothing else.
home.noAgentsHint: Ahabby found none of the agents it knows about. The agents page lists everything that can be installed.

activity.label: Activity
activity.noneHint: A skill or server appears here once it has been switched off, and nothing tells the agent to forget it.

agents.title: Agents
agents.emptyHint: Ahabby did not find any of the agents it knows about. Add a search path in Settings if yours live somewhere unusual.
agents.emptyAvailableHint: Every known agent is already installed on this machine.
agents.unverifiedHint: Some paths of this manifest have not been confirmed against the official documentation yet.
agents.problemsHint: One or more manifests could not be loaded. The affected agent is not listed.

filters.noResults: No agent matches the current filters

agents.removeChoose: Choose what should happen to this agent.
agents.removeHideHint: Keeps it installed on this machine. Nothing on disk is touched, and you can bring it back from Settings → Hidden agents.
agents.removeUninstallHint: Runs the agent's own uninstall command to remove it from disk. Ahabby keeps its manifest, so you can install it again later.
agents.removeDeleteManifestHint: Moves {{path}} to the OS trash. The agent itself is left installed.
agents.uninstallNoCommand: This agent declares no uninstall command for your platform.
agents.uninstallManagerMissing: Removing it needs {{manager}}, which is not installed.
agents.removedDeleted: {{name}} was removed and its manifest was moved to the trash

facts.title: Quick info
facts.hint: Notable values read from this agent's config files.

agent.notFound: This agent is not in the catalog any more.
agent.notInstalledHint: Ahabby knows how to manage this agent, but the executable is not on this machine.

browser.emptyTitle: Nothing to read on this page
browser.emptyHint: The page draws itself with its own scripts, and Ahabby runs no third-party code. Open it in your browser instead.
browser.truncated: The page is longer than the reader reads at once, so only its beginning is shown.

configs.title: Configuration files
configs.noneHint: The manifest of this agent does not declare any configuration file yet.
configs.notEditable: This file is declared read-only by the manifest.
configs.truncated: The file is too large to edit here ({{size}}). Open it in your editor instead.

editor.validationFailed: The file does not parse as {{format}} and will not be written.
editor.staleFile: This file changed on disk since you opened it.
editor.staleHint: Reload it to see the current content, then reapply your edit.
editor.restoreBody: The current content of {{file}} will be replaced by the backup from {{when}}. A backup of the current content is taken first.
editor.formatFailed: This text is not valid JSON, so it cannot be formatted.
editor.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard

skills.title: Global skills
skills.noneHint: Skills appear here once the agent has a skills directory with SKILL.md files.
skills.noneHintCreate: Write your own skill, or let an agent ship one — either way it appears here.
skills.name: Name
skills.noContent: This skill has no markdown body.
skills.createBody: Ahabby writes SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter into the skills directory of the owner you pick, so the agent loads it right away.
skills.createOwnerHint: Shared lives in ~/.agents and is available to every installed agent; an agent keeps its own skills.
skills.createNameHint: The directory is named after it: letters and digits become the folder name.
skills.createDescriptionPlaceholder: One line the agent shows next to the skill
skills.createContentHint: The markdown body the agent reads. You can edit it later from the skill card.
skills.createContentPlaceholder:
# Release notes

What the agent should do, step by step.
skills.deleteBody: The directory {{path}} will be moved to the system trash — you can restore it from there. Nothing is deleted permanently.
skills.notRemovable: Ahabby will not delete this one
skills.switchHint: Switched off, the entry file is renamed to SKILL.md.disabled — the agent stops loading the skill and nothing is deleted.

mcp.title: MCP servers
mcp.noneHint: Add servers with the agent's own CLI, or edit its config file here.
mcp.noneHintCreate: Add a server of your own, or configure one with the agent's CLI.
mcp.name: Name
mcp.createBody: The entry is written into the config file the selected owner already uses, in the shape that agent reads — nothing else in that file is touched.
mcp.createOwnerHint: Shared goes to ~/.agents/mcp.json and is available to every installed agent.
mcp.createTransportHint: Local starts a process on this machine; remote talks to a URL.
mcp.createPairsHint: One “KEY=value” per line. Values stay in the config file and are masked in the list.
mcp.deleteBody: The entry will be deleted from {{config}}. A timestamped backup is taken first, so you can undo this from Backups.
mcp.switchHint: Switched off, the entry is moved to the mcpServersDisabled object of the same file, where no agent looks for servers.

library.title: Library
library.subtitle: Everything installed across your agents
library.sharedHint: Available to every installed agent — it belongs to no single agent
library.emptyHint: Install an agent, or point Ahabby at your skills directory in Settings.
library.emptyHintCreate: Create your first one below, install an agent, or point Ahabby at your skills directory in Settings.

hub.title: Hub
hub.subtitle: Install skills and MCP servers from published collections
hub.noSourcesHint: Add a source file of your own, or check that the collections Ahabby ships with loaded — the problems above say what went wrong.
hub.sourceFailed: This collection could not be reached
hub.installBody: From “{{source}}”. Everything below is written to the owner you choose, exactly as reviewed.
hub.entryFailed: This entry could not be read from its collection
hub.writesFilesHint: These files are created in a new directory of the owner you choose; a skill that already exists is never overwritten.
hub.launchHint: Pre-filled from what the publisher declared — change it if your setup needs to.
hub.valuesHint: Written into the config of the owner you choose. A blank value is left out.
hub.targetHint: Global (~/.agents) is shared by every agent that reads the convention; an agent gets its own copy; a project gets it inside that project.
hub.name: Name
hub.nameHint: The directory (or config entry) it is written under.
hub.scriptsWarning: This skill ships scripts the agent may run — check the list below before installing.
hub.viewBody: From “{{source}}”. Nothing is written until you install it.
hub.noPreviewHint: This skill carries no entry file, or it is not text.
hub.previewTruncated: The instructions are longer than this preview shows.
hub.noRecipe: The collection does not say how to run this.
hub.refreshed: “{{name}}” was read again from its collection

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Your own folders, and the skills, MCP servers and documents each project holds
projects.addBody: Ahabby looks for projects inside this folder and reads each project's skills, MCP servers and files. Nothing is written until you edit something.
projects.pathHint: Pick it in the system dialog, or type the path.
projects.removeBody: The folder is only forgotten by Ahabby. Nothing on disk changes, and you can add it again at any time.
projects.emptyHint: Add a folder where your projects live — Ahabby will read each project's skills, MCP servers and documents.
projects.folderEmptyHint: Ahabby found no projects here. A directory that holds a project marker, or the added folder itself, counts as one.
projects.missingHint: This folder is not on disk right now — it was moved or deleted, or its drive is not mounted. It stays here until you remove it.
projects.filesEmpty: Ahabby found no addressable files in this project.
projects.notFound: This project is not in your folders any more.
projects.runTitle: Run an agent in this project
projects.runBody: Pick an installed agent to start in {{path}}.
projects.noAgents: No agent is installed yet — install one first.

install.title: Run command
install.confirmBody: Ahabby will run exactly this command from the agent's manifest. Nothing else is executed, and you can cancel at any time.
install.managerMissing: {{manager}} is not installed on this machine.
install.managerMissingHint: Install it first, or follow the official instructions instead.
install.cancelJobBody: The command is stopped immediately. An install or update that was already running can leave the agent half-installed.
install.uninstallHint: This command is destructive: it removes the agent from your machine.
install.noMethods: No install method is available for this platform.

terminal.newHint: Start an agent in a shell of its own. The tab keeps a full scrollback and stays open after the agent exits.
terminal.workingDirectoryHint: Where the agent starts. The directory has to exist already.
terminal.noAgents: Install an agent first — Ahabby only starts what it found on this machine.
terminal.openedDirectory: Opened {{terminal}} in the working directory — start the agent there
terminal.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard
terminal.pasteUnavailable: This window does not allow reading the clipboard — use Ctrl+V

tray.agentMissing: That agent is not in the last scan — scan the machine again and retry.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Every area of Ahabby, grouped — each section is its own page.
settings.languageHint: Applies to the whole interface immediately.
settings.appearanceHint: Changes are previewed live — press Save to keep them.
settings.accentHint: Used for buttons, links, focus rings and highlights.
settings.interfaceScaleHint: Scales spacing, controls, icons and corner radii.
settings.textScaleHint: Scales the type only — the layout stays put.
settings.codeFontHint: Used for code, file paths and the config editor.
settings.typeHint: How large the interface draws and which typefaces it uses.
settings.terminalHint: Where the “run in terminal” buttons send an agent. Every terminal is checked against this machine before it is offered.
settings.terminalBuiltinHint: Opens the docked panel at the bottom of the window: several agents in tabs, copy and paste, find and links.
settings.terminalOpensDirectory: {{terminal}} cannot be told to run a command, so Ahabby opens it in the working directory — start the agent there.
settings.terminalMissing: {{terminal}} is not installed any more. Ahabby falls back to the built-in terminal until it is back.
settings.terminalColorsHint: Paints the built-in terminal — background, text, cursor and the 16 ANSI colors. A fixed scheme looks the same in light and dark mode; “Ahabby” follows the app.
settings.terminalThemeAutoHint: Follows the app theme and accent
settings.previewBody: Versions, configs, skills and MCP servers — read locally, never uploaded.
settings.windowHint: How Ahabby starts, and what closing its window means.
settings.launchAtLoginHint: Ahabby starts together with your system and waits in the tray. The login item is listed in your operating system's startup settings as well — removing it there turns this off.
settings.trayHint: The tray icon is how Ahabby is reached while its window is closed. Right-click it for the menu: open the window, go to a screen, run an agent in the terminal, scan the machine again, or quit.
settings.trayIconHint: Without it, closing the window quits Ahabby.
settings.needsTray: Turn the tray icon on first.
settings.closeToTray: Keep running when the window is closed
settings.closeToTrayHint: The close button puts the window away instead of quitting, so a running install and the open terminal sessions survive. Use Quit in the tray menu to exit.
settings.startMinimizedHint: Ahabby opens without showing its window; click the tray icon to bring it back.
settings.searchHint: Where Ahabby looks for agent executables, and where extra agent definitions come from.
settings.scanPathsHint: Extra directories that are searched when looking for agent executables.
settings.scanPathsNone: No extra paths — the standard install locations are searched.
settings.networkHint: How Ahabby reaches the internet — nothing leaves your machine unless you allow it.
settings.networkChecksHint: Queries the npm registry or GitHub releases of the agents you have installed. Never sends any personal data. Scans work fine without it.
settings.proxyHint: Used for version checks and for every install/update command (npm, pip, cargo, brew, install scripts).
settings.proxyNoneHint: Connects directly: HTTP_PROXY / HTTPS_PROXY are ignored and removed from install commands.
settings.proxySystemHint: Uses HTTP_PROXY / HTTPS_PROXY from your environment, exactly like your shell and package managers do.
settings.proxyUrlHint: http:// or https:// only. Applied to new install and update jobs; a running job keeps the proxy it started with.
settings.backupDirHint: Every write to a config file is backed up here with a timestamp. Leave empty to use the default location.
settings.catalogDirHint: Drop extra agent manifests (TOML) here. A file with the same id overrides the built-in one.
settings.hiddenAgentsHint: Agents you removed that Ahabby can still see on disk. Restoring brings them back to the list.
settings.managersNone: None found — installs and updates will be unavailable.
settings.aboutText: Ahabby reads the configuration of your AI coding agents. It never sends your files anywhere, and every write is backed up first.
